Name: LK'S PORTRAIT COMPOSITOR v1.0
Author: LKally
Description:
LK's Portrait Compositor - Automated Sprite Sheet Generator
Tired of manually dragging 12 portraits into a grid? Spend 30 minutes aligning pixels? 
NEVER AGAIN!
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
✨ WHAT IS THIS?
A simple Python tool that automatically arranges your 12 HD portraits into a perfect 
2×6 sprite sheet for Stardew Valley NPC mods. 
Draw your portraits at ANY size (even 3000×3000!) → Run the tool → Get instant 
512×1536 sprite sheet ready for Content Patcher!
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
🎯 WHY USE THIS?
✓ Saves 30+ minutes of manual Photoshop/PAINT.NET dragging
✓ Perfect alignment every time (no more pixel-perfect OCD!)
✓ Automatic high-quality resizing (Lanczos resampling)
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
🎨 EMOTION LAYOUT (2×6 Grid)
Column 1:              Column 2:
01 - Neutral           02 - Happy
03 - Sad               04 - Serious  
05 - Blush/Flirty      06 - Angry
07 - Blushing Happy    08 - Surprised
09 - Happy Surprised   10 - Knowledgeable/Sly
11 - Tired             12 - Fuming
Just name your files 01.png through 12.png and the tool does the rest!
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
⚡ HOW IT WORKS
1. Draw/commission your 12 portraits (any size, PNG with transparency)
2. Name them: 01.png, 02.png, 03.png ... 12.png
3. Double-click portrait_compositor.py
4. Enter folder path → Enter NPC name
5. Drop the output into your [CP] mod!
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
📋 REQUIREMENTS
• Python 3.x (free download)
• Pillow library (pip install Pillow)
• 12 portrait images (PNG format)
Detailed installation guide included in README.txt!

• Anyone who hates manual sprite sheeting!
